description: The Client Engagement Associate uses 21st century life and employability skills to provide services and/or products to the companys customers. They are responsible for optimizing the last-mile delivery of the companys products and/or services and enhancing the happiness quotient of its customers. They must ensure that all quality and safety parameters of their job role are adhered to. They must strive to create a positive work environment by working with teams, being adaptable and imbibing a growth mindset.
